study.question: Observation and trajectory review: original joint incumbent g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached has click AUC 0.666753547526167 versus baseline-din 0.6555440824200336. Round24 zero-token controls fall to 0.6411900073135032 task / 0.6407085598818172 shared; context replacement 0.6414296870321845 did not recover this. Action in values but not scorer (round25) retains 0.6662444304756373 task; scorer-only 0.6541741279490947. Round26 removing either pools or summaries loses quality. Summary-only isolated match/ordinal branches (round27) were unsuccessful and restoring pools (round28) partially recovered them. Round30 rotating match actions loses more than ordinal rotation. Rounds34/36 item duplication, including blocked replacement gradients, did not recover the observed match-action endpoint. Observed/blocked round37 AUC=0.6661693800470533 task / 0.6646058217528154 shared. Rotated/blocked round38 remains worse (0.663743611195438 task / 0.661977114412632 shared). Rounds39/40 retain one observed summary and replace or duplicate the other; neither duplication recovers the original two-summary score. g1-r0040-match_raw_duplicate_task: AUC=0.665715537321, delta to observed/blocked task=-0.000453842726; g1-r0040-match_scaled_duplicate_task: AUC=0.665766548422, delta to observed/blocked task=-0.000402831625; g1-r0040-match_raw_duplicate_shared: AUC=0.663766757386, delta to observed/blocked shared=-0.000839064366; g1-r0040-match_scaled_duplicate_shared: AUC=0.664391245167, delta to observed/blocked shared=-0.000214576586. All are frozen-seed local observations, without independent mechanism repetitions or uncertainty intervals; no failed training is indicated in the available trajectory index. Repeated identical ancestor endpoints are not independent confirmations. Latest knowledge usage declared DIN-inspired scale attribution but imported no hub/transduction architecture; the four executed r0040 sources and receipts establish provenance and scores, not confirmation of the scale hypothesis. The remaining ambiguity is information removal versus coordinate presentation/optimization, including loss of original action/item slot pairing. This study retains both already-contracted action summaries while varying only their basis. Question: does the observed advantage of distinct raw/scaled action summaries survive exact slot exchange and approximately invertible norm-preserving mixing, and is that sensitivity affected by task versus shared residual routing?
study.hypothesis: The raw/scaled pair contributes a useful joint signal beyond a duplicated single summary. Retaining the full pair under fixed invertible basis changes should preserve most of its utility if information content is the main explanation; substantial loss under exact swap would instead expose a coordinate/initialization/optimization explanation. A dense orthogonal change additionally probes conditioning while preserving function class in exact arithmetic. This is a falsifiable representation attribution study, not a new architecture or novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add architecture-only match_action_basis with identity/swap/hadamard. Submitted cells use observed content, blocked derivatives, both rows available and all summary channels; identity supports all existing bridge configurations. For swap return detached row4 in action row0 and detached row0 in action row4. For Hadamard return FP32 (raw+scaled)/sqrt(2) and (raw-scaled)/sqrt(2), cast back, in rows0/4; rows1/2/3 are exact slices. Both transforms are information-preserving in real arithmetic (swap exact at inherited precision); no summary coefficients or per-block support gates are changed. Gates outside the helper remain inherited. Four standalone source modules implement the2x2 changed-basis/routing suite, with existing identity endpoints completing a3x2 comparison. Before attribution the host must run finite FP32 and frozen-BF16 train/eval forward and backward for all four labels; compare learned state keys/shapes, initialization, host RNG state, measured counts (inherited expectation 32129765 total, 31793216 embedding, 336549 dense) and buffers. No new learned tensor, normalization, buffer, randomness or loss is introduced. At common weights including nonzero residual output layers, require exact identity-basis bridge forward, buffers, probabilities/loss, dense and coalesced sparse gradients (including None versus zero) and one frozen optimizer-step parity with the r0040 module configured observed/blocked, and if materialized the original r0037 observed/blocked module. Also require exact duplicate bridge parity with materialized r0040 raw/scaled sources for both routings. Basis=identity executes the ancestor helper unchanged; source AST checks can certify this code path only. For new bases probe the helper with arbitrary independent rows, not only naturally collinear data: swap twice is exact; Hadamard applied twice recovers the original pair approximately and preserves pair squared norm before cast. Row0/row4 are both detached; selected-output-only losses have zero local derivative to every incoming action and item summary, while mixed probes retain identity Jacobian for rows1/2/3. Whole action-table gradients need not vanish because pool/ordinal paths remain live. At common parameter state require unchanged item coordinates, ordinal rows, target/count/coefficients, all original masks, compression populations, scorer inputs/outputs, direct pools and auxiliary ownership; do not require unchanged final predictions at arbitrary identical weights for a nonidentity basis. Both availability and summary-family gates still execute afterwards; nonidentity configs reject any partial availability, changed summary family/alignment group, unblocked match derivatives or replacement content. Verify current target action and legal masked-history ID/action perturbation invariance on empty, singleton, partial, noncontiguous and full histories; missing or malformed masks must be rejected. Use exact comparisons for swap and same-arithmetic bridges; use FP32 rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-6 for independent formula references, and BF16 rtol=0.02/atol=0.002. Additionally bound Hadamard reconstruction L2 error by 0.02*pair_L2+0.002 and relative squared-norm error by 0.02 (absolute 0.002 for a near-zero pair). Report residuals and abort attribution if these predeclared checks fail; no tolerance retuning after scores. A common-function diagnostic can permute each residual bank first-affine action-column pair for swap; compare outputs within numeric tolerance after remapping. Do not demand identical trajectories under AdamW with a dense orthogonal remapping: coordinatewise optimizer state is not generally rotation equivariant. BF16 rounding can lose information and prevents claims of exact invertibility for Hadamard. Read training-only pair RMS/support counts/norm errors without fitting a scale. Measure full-population validation click AUC, unweighted four-task Logloss and AUC, auxiliary mean, inherited history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts, train/wall/allocated GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. No diagnostics runner is exposed in this proposal phase, torch is absent, and prior receipts mark candidate_diagnostics=not_requested; these checks are pending requirements, not claimed executions. Current data/checkpoint access does not permit independently rerunning the baseline here; verified source hashes and committed receipts are the reproducible starting evidence. No access to withheld outcomes. Completed local checks: supplied study JSON schema and reference IDs, four syntax compilations without import, CONFIG/proposal agreement, standalone program identity outside CONFIG, AST isolation of constructor/helper additions, exact AST identity of every other inherited method and old helper with new branch removed, and normalized-default r0040 ancestor comparison all passed. Earlier overly strict ancestor-comparison assertion is retained in cost_plan. This is static evidence only; no tensors, performance, precision or optimizer behavior were tested.
predictions: Predeclared exploratory screen: each basis change loses less than0.0002 click AUC relative to its routing-matched r0037 identity endpoint; the original-minus-duplicate gaps range0.000214576586..0.000839064366. This margin is a practical screen only: one-seed point estimates cannot establish equivalence or significance.

Exact swap should be closer to identity than the information-removing raw/scaled duplicates if joint content dominates. Hadamard may expose additional optimizer sensitivity even though it retains both input summaries.

Task/shared basis interaction D_basis is near zero if routing dependence is principally informational; a reproducible nonzero interaction indicates representation/optimization dependence conditional on the existing bank implementation.
Unchanged learned parameter count and source-state layout; tiny extra fixed helper cost, to be measured. No quality-cost superiority prediction is made.
falsifiers: Exact-swap AUC losses comparable to duplication losses weaken the account that all duplication loss measures information removal; information is retained by this permutation.
Hadamard failing inverse/norm precision gates or identity bridge failing tensor/optimizer parity invalidates representation-based attribution for that arm.
A consequential contrast failing host-authorized paired repetition, or an interaction interval covering zero, weakens the corresponding mechanistic claim.
Restoration by a slot permutation alone, or performance explained by original action/item pairing, supports coordinate presentation rather than a uniquely necessary raw/scaled information geometry.
Any changed input mask, target action influence, auxiliary ownership, learned capacity or frozen recipe invalidates the planned contrasts.
alternative_explanations: The raw/scaled pair is samplewise related by input-dependent coefficient scaling/support in exact arithmetic; this study does not assert two independent event directions or causal behavior effects. Finite precision complicates exact collinearity.
Duplicating a row changes variance, correlations, pairing with item summaries and optimizer conditioning; occupied slot count alone is not enough to match capacity in use.
Random first-layer columns, ReLU activation regions, fixed AdamW coordinate updates and dense clipping can make equally expressive bases differ under one-pass scratch training.
Task/shared differences may reflect effective sharing, auxiliary gradient competition or optimization rather than intrinsic task-conditioned semantics.
Whole-window filtering and official_offline delayed feedback are inherited; results cannot establish online availability or advertisement-level conversion causality.

Inherited click improvements accompany much weaker auxiliary metrics in recent controls (e.g. r0037 task mean AUC0.735747 versus DIN0.809923); click-only selection does not establish joint-task superiority.
